This is the General Availability release of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source.

### Major changes compared to 8.10

- Compressed bitmaps — Integrated redis-roaring into Redis core for lower memory usage and faster bitmap operations. 
Special thanks to Antonio Viggiano, the original creator of redis-roaring, for contributing this capability!
- Substantial memory reduction for large sorted set with a new B+ tree encoding 
- New command: `BITRANGEINTARRAY` equivalent to redis-roaring’s `R.RANGEINTARRAY`, to return set bit offsets within a specified range
- Set member expiration: New commands: `SEXPIRE`,`SPEXPIRE`,`SEXPIREAT`,`SPEXPIREAT` - set expiration of a Set member; `STTL`, `SPTTL`, `SEXPIRETIME`,`SPEXPIRETIME` - retrieve remaining TTLs or expiration timestamps; `SETPERSIST` - remove the expiration of members 
- New command: `BLESS` - avoid eviction of specified keys
- New commands: `ZMOVE`, `BZMOVE` and ‘ZMOVEMEMBER‘ - atomic sorted-set moves for end-of-set batches and destination conditions 
- Count-min-sketch extensions
- Auto create JSON deep path
- Opt-in SQ8 new compression is now available for HNSW vector indexes
- `CLUSTER MIGRATION STATUS` now reports progress for both the snapshot and incremental migration phases
- Redis query engine: `FT.ALTER` avoids unnecessary document reindexing during schema additions
- Redis query engine: `EXPLAINSCORE` is now supported for `FT.HYBRID`
- Redis query engine: `RETURN_STRICT` timeout handling is now enabled for local `FT.HYBRID` execution

### Bug fixes (compared to 8.12 RC-3)

- #16252 HOTKEYS GET reported a wrong collection-duration-ms after 2^31 milliseconds
- #16219 HPERSIST ignored a replicated or AOF persist of a field the local clock had already expired
- #16207 Replicas misbehaved when replication compression was enabled
- #16267 BITCOUNT returned wrong results on AArch64 for large dense bitmaps 
- #16081 Addresses and names announced on the cluster bus were accepted without validation 
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2234 Fix a crash when loading persisted compaction rules with an invalid aggregation type (MOD-20881).
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1692 Fix JSON.ARRINSERT partially modifying arrays before returning a validation error (MOD-9116).
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1090 Improve TopK write performance by initializing the seed generator once, reducing per-command random-seed generation overhead.

data.name: 8.12 RC3
data.body:
This is the third Release Candidate of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source.

Release Candidates are feature-complete pre-releases. Pre-releases are not suitable for production use.

### Security fixes

- #16127 A TLS session could be resumed on another listener (client port vs. cluster bus), or after `tls-auth-clients` or `tls-expected-peer-name` changed, without the checks of the new settings

### New Features

- #16135 New commands: `ZMOVE`, `BZMOVE`, `ZMOVEMEMBER` to atomically move members between sorted sets - from either end, by score range, or by name - with `COUNT` batching and `NX`/`XX` destination conditions
- #15907 `SLOWLOG GET` now reports the CPU time of each slow command (a new 8th field), to tell commands that ran slowly apart from commands that were starved of CPU; New configuration parameter: `off-cpu-tracking`

### Modules API

- #16105 `RedisModule_GetUsedMemoryRatioEstimate` - like `RedisModule_GetUsedMemoryRatio`, but can be called from module threads without holding the GIL

### Bug fixes

- #16098 A replica that fell behind by more than its output buffer soft limit was disconnected even when `repl-backlog-size` was larger
- #16176 Keys could be lost during atomic slot migration when the destination rejected a command (e.g. `-NOREPLICAS` due to `min-replicas-to-write`)
- #16210 Set members could be expired incorrectly on the destination during atomic slot migration
- #16096 `MSETEX` with repeated `EX` or `PX` options was propagated to replicas and the AOF as an invalid command, losing the keys
- #16175 Commands could be replayed twice on AOF load when an AOF rewrite started after an AOF write error (e.g. disk full)
- #15955 `XADD` entries with `IDMP` could be lost on AOF replay or on a lagging replica, and `XIDMPRECORD` could crash a lagging replica
- #15930 Consumers created by `XCLAIM` or `XAUTOCLAIM` that claimed no entries were not propagated to replicas or the AOF
- #16121 Some key updates could apply the value or TTL to a different key while the keyspace was being resized
- #16042 Redis could crash with `io-threads` > 1 when running module commands that use `getkeys-api` or `getchannels-api`
- #16165 Redis could crash when a module read a sorted set emptied by `ZPOPMIN`/`ZPOPMAX` from its keyspace notification
- #16125 `ZRANGESTORE` with the same source and destination key could cause a use-after-free when `key-memory-histograms` or `cluster-slot-stats-enabled` is enabled
- #16167 `ZRANGESTORE` could create a sorted set with a broken score order when the source was a listpack loaded from an unordered payload
- #16164 A sorted set restored without `sanitize-dump-payload` could store a duplicate member twice after its conversion to the B+tree encoding
- #16146 A malformed `RESTORE` payload or RDB file could corrupt memory (only with modules that register key metadata classes)
- #16142 `CONFIG GET` and `CONFIG REWRITE` dropped the `n`, `o` and `c` flags of `notify-keyspace-events` when `A` was set, so these events stopped after a restart
- #16120 `DELEX` honored `lazyfree-lazy-server-del` instead of `lazyfree-lazy-user-del`
- #16203 Lua scripts with very deep string patterns could exhaust the stack; such patterns now fail with `pattern too complex`
- #16233 Redis could crash when using `preload-file` with AOF and a working directory of 1024 bytes or longer
- #16062 On FreeBSD, the bundled jemalloc took over libc's malloc hooks, which could crash multi-threaded tools (e.g. `redis-benchmark --threads`) and deadlock after `fork()`
- #16117 `redis-cli` could generate excessive help entries from a `COMMAND` reply with extreme arity values
- #15823 `redis-cli --keystats` printed empty statistics when no keys were found

### Performance and resource utilization improvements

- #15622 `SORT` and `SORT_RO` no longer convert listpack-encoded sorted sets to B+tree, which increased their memory usage (also on read-only replicas)
- #16163 `ZADD` that converts a sorted set to B+tree no longer leaves an oversized member index, which wasted memory and slowed `ZSCAN`
- #16069 Client memory (`tot-mem`, `mem_clients_normal`, `maxmemory-clients`) now includes the names of watched keys and of Pub/Sub channels and patterns
- #16126 Faster `ZRANGESTORE` for large `REV` rank ranges
- #16156 Faster `ZRANDMEMBER` with a large positive count on B+tree sorted sets
- #15420 Faster `SRANDMEMBER` with a positive count on hashtable-encoded sets
- #15901 Faster `HEXPIRE` and `HSETEX` updates of field expiration on listpack-encoded hashes

This is the first Release Candidate of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source.

Release Candidates are feature-complete pre-releases. Pre-releases are not suitable for production use.

### Headlines:

Redis 8.12 introduces new features and performance improvements.

### Operating systems we test Redis 8.12 on

- Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy Jellyfish), 24.04 (Noble Numbat), 26.04 (Resolute Raccoon)
- Rocky Linux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1
- AlmaLinux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1
- Debian 12.13 (Bookworm), Debian 13.4 (Trixie)
- Alpine 3.23
- macOS 14.8.4 (Sonoma), 15.7.4 (Sequoia), 26.3 (Tahoe) - for both Intel and ARM

### Security fixes
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10073 Indexed value hashing is now collision-resistant, preventing HashDoS-style index degradation from adversarial input. (MOD-14459)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11202 Incomplete UTF-8 characters no longer reads out of bounds in indexed TEXT fields. (MOD-18088)

### New Features

- #15331 Compressed bitmaps — Integrated redis-roaring into Redis core for lower memory usage and faster bitmap operations. 
Special thanks to Antonio, the original creator of redis-roaring, for contributing this capability! https://redisroaring.com/redis-merge/#/1; 
- #15986 New command: `BITRANGEINTARRAY` equivalent to redis-roaring’s `R.RANGEINTARRAY`, to return set bit offsets within a specified range
- #15938 Set expiration to individual set member; New commands: `SEXPIRE`,`SPEXPIRE`,`SEXPIREAT`,`SPEXPIREAT` to set expiration and `STTL`, `SPTTL`, `SEXPIRETIME`,`SPEXPIRETIME` to retrieve remaining TTLs or expiration timestamps
- #15649 Bless keys: avoid eviction of specified keys; New command: `BLESS`
- #15829 `CLUSTER MIGRATION STATUS` now reports progress for both the snapshot and incremental migration phases
- #15556 `TLS` named groups can now be configured using `tls-groups`
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1063 Count-min-sketch extensions: Added optional `CELL_SIZE` support to `CMS.INITBYDIM` and `CMS.INITBYPROB` for lower memory usage, negative increments in `CMS.INCRBY` to decrement counts, and cell size reporting in `CMS.INFO`
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1640 Auto-create JSON deep path 
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10151 `EXPLAINSCORE` is now supported for `FT.HYBRID`. (MOD-10044)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11330 SQ8 new compression is now available for HNSW vector fields. (MOD-6132)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10247 `RETURN_STRICT` timeout handling is now enabled for local `FT.HYBRID` execution. (MOD-16492)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11278 `FT.ALTER` avoids unnecessary document reindexing during schema additions. (MOD-18171)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11384 Score/payload-only hash updates avoid reindexing. (MOD-18182)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11230 Hash documents are no longer re-indexed when no vector indexed field is touched. (MOD-17688)

### Bug fixes
- #15569 Changes made by `XDELEX DELREF` for already-deleted stream entries could fail to propagate to replicas or the AOF
- #15508 Operations using random radix-tree traversal could behave incorrectly when starting from certain leaf nodes
- #15604 Memory usage could be calculated incorrectly for hashes using shared templates
- #15489 RDB files could fail to load after `XSETID` reduced a stream’s entries_added counter
- #15626 `SET` could calculate an incorrect expiration time when given an excessively large relative `TTL`
- #15628 Active defragmentation could incorrectly handle the shared-template registry used by compact hashes
- #15530 After failover, a replica could remain connected to another replica instead of the new primary
- #15733 Invalid cluster slot ranges could be accepted after being merged into a valid range
- #15756 `RESTORE` could calculate an incorrect expiration time when given an excessively large relative `TTL`
- #15699 Memory growth could be accounted for incorrectly when `SETBIT` or `BITFIELD` expanded a string
- #15815 `XTRIM` could leave a stream in a state that prevented an RDB file containing it from loading
- #15795 Clients could fail to receive a protocol error when a malformed command arrived across multiple network reads
- #15875 `ARLASTITEMS` could omit elements appearing after a gap in an array
- #15916 Data could be lost when a legacy AOF file was upgraded before loading completed
- #15917 Hiredis clients on Linux could mishandle errors when establishing TCP connections
- #15869 Redis could crash when a module thread paused I/O threads
- #15468 - Pub/Sub subscriptions could remain active after the subscribing user’s channel permissions were revoked or the user was deleted, if the client had re-authenticated as another user.
- #15623 Module actions scheduled by hash-field expiration notifications could be delayed after fields expired in the background
- #15680 Data could be lost after a replica migrated to a different shard
- #15587 `LMOVEM` could emit keyspace notifications inconsistent with those produced by `LMOVE`
- #15695 Command side effects could be propagated to replicas or the AOF despite settings that should have excluded them
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10872 Shard no longer crashes with SIGSEGV when `RESTORE` of a legacy `ft_index0` payload is issued outside an RDB load. (MOD-15685)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10728 GC timer arming off the main thread on ARM no longer causes random shard crashes after extended uptime. (MOD-17309)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10767 Server no longer crashes on writes when an index `FILTER` references no schema fields. (MOD-15592)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11303, RediSearch/RediSearch#11304, RediSearch/RediSearch#11308, RediSearch/RediSearch#11309, RediSearch/RediSearch#11310, RediSearch/RediSearch#11311 `FT.ALTER SCHEMA ADD` running concurrently with queries under `WORKERS>0` no longer crashes query execution across VECTOR, TAG, NUMERIC, GEO, ISMISSING, and GEOSHAPE nodes. (MOD-18356, MOD-18361, MOD-18366, MOD-18367, MOD-18368)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11474 `FT.AGGREGATE` with the numeric `SORTBY` optimizer no longer crashes or returns wrong results. (MOD-6967)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10209 Coordinator no longer crashes under RESP2 when `FT.PROFILE HYBRID` hits a return-strict timeout. (MOD-16396)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10145 TEXT PHONETIC matches now behave correctly when non-TEXT fields precede TEXT fields in the schema. (MOD-16304)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11262 `FT.AGGREGATE` cursor with `FILTER` now reports the correct result count. (MOD-18172)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11282 `FT.EXPLAIN` now renders a multi-word tag value as a single tag rather than an `INTERSECT`. (MOD-8666)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10768 `NOT` queries no longer leak excluded documents or drop results after a concurrent index change. (MOD-17394)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10637 Numeric index cardinality and bounds are now correct under float compression. (MOD-16877)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10704 Empty wildcard patterns no longer cause out-of-bounds writes or spurious empty-value matches. (MOD-17451)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10752 Wildcard `?` on `WITHSUFFIXTRIE` TEXT fields now matches per codepoint rather than per byte. (MOD-17476)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10112 Suffix-trie wildcard queries on TEXT fields are now case-insensitive. (MOD-16259)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11450 Matching literal `*` no longer hangs on the indexed string.
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11267 Duplicate vector results are no longer returned during tiered indexing. (MOD-17795)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10731 `FT.SEARCH` on cluster now returns an error for invalid `LIMIT` arguments, matching standalone behavior. (MOD-12465)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10251 `FT.SEARCH` under `WORKERS>0` no longer returns a nil field-array for documents re-indexed mid-query. (MOD-16507)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10921 Sort keys with embedded NUL bytes are no longer truncated in replies.
- RediSearch/RediSearch#9963 Trie `RangeIter` now preserves the excluded-empty lower bound. (MOD-15897)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10085 `RETURN_STRICT` safe-loader no longer deadlocks the GIL on client timeout. (MOD-16267)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11449 Index reference leak after queued search cancellation no longer occurs. (MOD-18682)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11369 Memory leaks after coordinator `SEARCH` cancellation no longer occur. (MOD-18548)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10110 `FT.HYBRID` cursor setup now has a bounded channel timeout. (MOD-16145)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10211, RediSearch/RediSearch#10745 `RETURN_STRICT` cursors are now depleted on timeout; strict-timed-out hybrid cursor cycles drop their cursors at cycle end. (MOD-16091, MOD-16991)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10947 Coordinator cursor memory is now capped via `INDEX_CURSOR_LIMIT`. (MOD-17479)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10766, RediSearch/RediSearch#10763 Cursor reads no longer time out against a deadline belonging to an earlier read, and now correctly reports a timeout that expires while iterators are revalidated. (MOD-17489, MOD-17488)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10993 RDB and replication payloads no longer leak a stray heap byte. (MOD-17800)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10074 `FT.HYBRID` now returns a stable RRF result order across cluster shards. (MOD-12438)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11027 Cluster TLS connections now use Redis node metadata, aligning with topology changes. (MOD-15869)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10380, RediSearch/RediSearch#10430 Cluster topology is now refreshed on topology-change events rather than by polling. (MOD-15868, MOD-15870)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10835 Coordinator fanout now preserves binary argument lengths.
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11095 Replica stalls during `FT.DROPINDEX DD` are reduced.
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10255 Blocked search clients no longer trigger eager query dumps. (MOD-16518)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10083 Internal query arguments missing during rolling upgrade are now tolerated. (MOD-16047)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10816 Forced GC now waits for a concurrent child process instead of skipping its cycle.
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10958 Async disk read pool no longer spins when saturated; it blocks instead.
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10646, RediSearch/RediSearch#10392 VectorSimilarity dependency refreshed to address unaligned metadata access on ARM/SVE paths. (MOD-15303, MOD-16696)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10352 `FT.PROFILE ON_TIMEOUT FAIL` now reports a pre-execution timeout as a warning rather than an error. (MOD-16660)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10870 Crash reports now include in-flight coordinator aggregate, hybrid, and cursor-read queries. (MOD-16992)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11089 Debug aggregate request synchronization no longer crashes. (MOD-17616)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10063 `COLLECT LIMIT` now honors the configurable `search-max-aggregate-results`
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1636 Fixed array-index normalization overflow for extreme negative indexes, including i64::MIN, affecting commands such as `JSON.ARRTRIM`
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1648 Corrected `JSON.MGET` key-spec metadata to identify all key arguments and exclude the trailing JSONPath argument.
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1670 Fixed downstream compilation when using redis_json_module_create! with the as-library feature and the new RDB depth configuration
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1035 TDIGEST.QUANTILE, TDIGEST.CDF, and TDIGEST.TRIMMED_MEAN could return NaN for a sketch containing exactly one observation
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1053 RDB loading and RESTORE did not consistently reject invalid numeric values, allocation sizes, serialized counts, or inconsistent metadata in Bloom filters, Count-Min Sketches, Top-K sketches, and t-digests; Bloom filter growth also lacked overflow checks
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1053 Top-K sketches containing nonempty items with zero counts or empty-string items with nonzero counts could be restored incorrectly
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1067 Bloom filters with excessive hash-function counts could be accepted during loading and restoration, including through BF.LOADCHUNK
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1062 CMS.MERGE key metadata did not correctly identify the destination and all source keys, affecting cluster slot validation
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1071 CF.COMPACT command metadata was missing its argument count and key specification

### Performance and resource utilization improvements

- #15618 Batch updates to hashes using shared templates now run more efficiently
- #15018 Supported x86 systems now use the processor-based monotonic clock by default, with runtime calibration to reduce timing overhead
- #15782 RDB and AOF loading now provides sequential-read hints to the operating system to improve loading efficiency
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10169 Searches on indexes using field-level expiration (`HEXPIRE`) are faster. (MOD-16350)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10981, RediSearch/RediSearch#11065 Coordinator field lookup and row-reply serialization overhead is reduced. (MOD-17924)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11055, RediSearch/RediSearch#11056, RediSearch/RediSearch#11057 Cluster reply conversion, result destruction, and `GROUPBY` cleanup have reduced overhead. (MOD-17908, MOD-17909, MOD-17910)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11507, RediSearch/RediSearch#11506 Query replies now format integral numeric values without `snprintf` and declare reply collection lengths up front. (MOD-18800, MOD-18799)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11509 Hash field loading for `RETURN` and `LOAD` no longer requires per-field allocations. (MOD-18811)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10246 Concurrent writes are now allowed during vector range queries. (MOD-16437)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10515 Coordinator requests are now allocated on the main thread, removing `CoordRequestCtx`. (MOD-16990)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11018 Query usage is now separated from administrative index operations. (MOD-17536)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10066 Shard response barrier removed in favor of async iterator depletion callback for `FT.AGGREGATE WITHCOUNT`. (MOD-16210)
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1645 More accurate memory usage reporting for shared strings: Memory usage now accounts for each reference’s proportional share of a shared string’s allocation, including its header and padding, instead of charging the full allocation to every reference
- J1660 Reduced object memory consumption: JSON parsing now uses compact object allocation to reduce the actual memory needed to store JSON objects 
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1661 Improved JSONPath parsing and evaluation by reducing parser backtracking, temporary allocations, and repeated traversal. Optimizations include caching root-path operands across filter candidates, stopping existence checks at the first match, and reducing overhead in regex matching and string comparisons
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1631 Improved typed-array element access through direct indexing, avoiding repeated iteration and quadratic work during full indexed scans 
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1049 Improved t-digest compression performance for inputs containing many duplicate values. Sorting is now bounded to O(n log n), avoiding quadratic behavior on pathological inputs

### Configuration parameters

- Redis-roaring:`bitmap-default-roaring` - to enable the new roaring bitmaps type, disabled by default 
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1657 Configurable RDB depth validation: Added `json-legacy-rdb-depth-limit`, disabled by default, to enforce a maximum nesting depth of 128 when loading JSON from RDB or through RESTORE
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1640 Added`json-auto-create-deep-paths` and is disabled by default and can only be configured at load time. Use the same value on every node of a shard and when replaying AOF files, because differing values can cause data divergence

## Metrics

- #15374 `INFO` keysizes histograms now include streams, providing visibility into stream key sizes
- #15682 Streams observability – Added `INFO STREAMS` with per-database histograms of consumer groups per stream, pending entries per group, and consumers per group. Enable with stream-stats yes (disabled by default)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10097 `FT.INFO` now exposes the default `EF_RUNTIME`. (MOD-16147)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10107 Disk GC `bytes_collected` and cycle stats are now reported in `FT.INFO`. (MOD-14621)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10464 `FT.INFO` on coordinator now aggregates per-field disk metrics via the reducer. (MOD-14859)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10204 Redis `INFO` now breaks down query timeout metrics by pipeline stage. (MOD-13192)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11521 Index metrics are no longer collected for unrelated `INFO` sections. (MOD-18033)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10536 `FT.PROFILE` loader-field timing resolution is improved. (MOD-17132)

### Behavior changes

- RediSearch/RediSearch#10109 `FT.CREATE` rejects `RERANK` on HNSW vector fields in RAM mode. (MOD-16015)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10200 Disk indexes reject `DIALECT 4` and `WITHOUTCOUNT`. (MOD-15997)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10082 `COLLECT` requires an `@` prefix for field names. (MOD-16233)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11106 JSON `HIGHLIGHT`/`SUMMARIZE` fields with multi-value JSONPath are now rejected. (MOD-16530)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10208 Non-cacheable commands are now marked with `dont_cache`. (MOD-16175)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10699 Numeric command arguments are now strictly parsed. (MOD-17409)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#11335 Search module now requires Redis 8.9.241 or newer to load. (MOD-15868)
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1063 Rejected `CMS.INCRBY` item updates now leave counters and the total count unchanged instead of saturating counters on overflow. Multi-item commands can still partially succeed.
- `RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1063 CMS.MERGE` now requires matching cell sizes across the destination and all sources.

### Modules API

- #15517 Modules can now retrieve a cluster node’s TLS port using the new REDISMODULE_NODE_PORT_TLS flag in RM_GetClusterNodeInfo()
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1623 Added `getWithPath` in shared API V9 to evaluate a precompiled JSONPath, allowing callers to compile a path once and reuse it across documents. 
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1666 Added `pathParseNoErrorMsg` in shared API V10 to compile JSONPaths without a Redis context or an allocated error message. Returns a compiled handle on success or NULL on failure. 
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1653 Made pre-command hooks optional and allowed hook errors to abort JSON commands before execution. Hooks now return `RedisResult<()>`; shared C API calls continue to ignore hook errors.
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1640 Extended the Rust Manager interface with clone_value and create_object to support construction of missing paths. Custom implementations must implement these methods and satisfy the new `Borrow<Self::V>` requirement for owned values.

This is the General Availability release of Redis 8.10 in Redis Open Source.

### Major changes compared to 8.8

- Compact hashes - a new hash encoding that reduces memory usage by storing hash field names just once for keys that share a schema
- New command: `HIMPORT` - high-throughput compact hash bulk insertion
- TLS peer certificate-based server-to-server authentication
- New commands: `LMOVEM`, `BLMOVEM` - move multiple elements between lists
- New command: `SUNIONCARD` - get the cardinality of the union of multiple sets
- New command: `SDIFFCARD` - get the cardinality of the difference between sets
- New command: `BACKUP` - node-side implementation for backup and restore based on multi-part AOF (MP-AOF)
- `XREAD`, `XREADGROUP` - new `MAXCOUNT` and `MAXSIZE` arguments to cap the cumulative reply entries and size
- New command: `FT.ALIASLIST` - get all aliases for the index 
- Stemmer support for Malay and Tagalog languages 
- JSONPath extensions
- New commands: `TS.NRANGE`, `TS.NREVRANGE` - Query a range across multiple time series; group results by timestamp 
- New command: `TS.READ` - optionally blocking read
- New command: `TS.QUERYLABELS` - Get a list of labels and label-values 
- New command: `TS.MRANGE`, `TS.MREVRANGE` - new `EXCLUDEEMPTY` argument to exclude series with no reported samples 
- Performance improvements 

### Binary distributions

- Alpine and Debian Docker images - https://hub.docker.com/_/redis
- Install using snap - see https://github.com/redis/redis-snap
- Install using brew - see https://github.com/redis/homebrew-redis
- Install using RPM - see https://github.com/redis/redis-rpm
- Install using Debian APT - see https://github.com/redis/redis-debian


### Operating systems we test Redis 8.10 on

- Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy Jellyfish), 24.04 (Noble Numbat), 26.04 (Resolute Raccoon)
- Rocky Linux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1
- AlmaLinux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1

- Alpine 3.23
- macOS 14.8.4 (Sonoma), 15.7.4 (Sequoia), 26.3 (Tahoe) - for both Intel and ARM

### Bug fixes (compared to 8.10-RC2)

- #15513 Prevented a division-by-zero error when active defragmentation thresholds are configured with equal or reversed value
- #15453 Clients blocked on `BLPOP`, `BLMOVE`, or `BLMOVEM` could remain blocked after `SORT` with `STORE` replaced the target key with a list
- #15499 Memory usage reported for compressed replication clients could be lower than the actual memory consumed
- #15518 notify modules when node's own ip/port changes
- #15539 Loading an AOF file with an RDB preamble could fail when active defragmentation was enabled
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10528 Crash in the numeric range tree when background garbage collection encounters an empty leaf during active indexing on a numeric field. (MOD-16877)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10605 FT.CREATE and FT.ALTER now reject an empty string as a field name, preventing a crash loop in the fork-GC on indexes with an empty TAG field. (MOD-17034)

data.body:
This is the first Release Candidate of Redis 8.10 in Redis Open Source.

Release Candidates are feature-complete pre-releases. Pre-releases are not suitable for production use.

### Headlines:

Redis 8.10 introduces new features and performance improvements.

### Operating systems we test Redis 8.10 on

- Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy Jellyfish), 24.04 (Noble Numbat), 26.04 (Resolute Raccoon)
- Rocky Linux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1
- AlmaLinux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1
- Debian 12.13 (Bookworm), Debian 13.4 (Trixie)
- Alpine 3.23
- macOS 14.8.4 (Sonoma), 15.7.4 (Sequoia), 26.3 (Tahoe) - for both Intel and ARM

### New Features (compared to 8.8)

- #15364 Compact hashes - a new hash encoding that reduces memory usage by storing hash field names just once for keys that share a schema
- #15366 Replication stream compression to reduce bandwidth consumption between primaries and replicas
- #15364 New command: `HIMPORT` - high-throughput compact hash bulk insertion
- #15405 New commands: `LMOVEM`, `BLMOVEM` - move multiple elements between lists
- #14893 New command: `SUNIONCARD` - get the cardinality of the union of multiple sets
- #15278 New command: `SDIFFCARD` - get the cardinality of the difference between sets
- #15441 New command: `BACKUP` - node-side implementation for backup and restore based on multi-part AOF (MP-AOF)
- #15282 `XREAD`, `XREADGROUP` - new `MAXCOUNT` and `MAXSIZE` arguments to cap the cumulative reply entries and size
- #15337 New `SCRIPT_RUNNER` command flag: flag commands that execute scripts or functions
- #15347 `SLOWLOG GET` - new reply argument: total argument count
- RediSearch/RediSearch#9626 New command: `FT.ALIASLIST` - get all aliases for the index (RED-197340)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#9052 New Languages Search: Stemmer support for Malay and Tagalog languages (RED-132425)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#9291 `FT.AGGREGATE` now supports whole-document fetching using `COLLECT`, in-group SORTBY/LIMIT, and deduplication control within a single query. (RED-177887)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#8169, RediSearch/RediSearch#8236, RediSearch/RediSearch#9234, RediSearch/RediSearch#9443 — `FT.SEARCH`, `FT.AGGREGATE`, `FT.HYBRID`: enforce query `TIMEOUT` more strictly; long-running queries require vertical scaling (multi-threaded execution). (RED-132340)
  - use `FAIL` when correctness requires rejecting timed-out queries. With `search-workers` > 0` (the default), the timeout is enforced preemptively
  - use `RETURN` when best-effort partial results are acceptable and strictness not enforced at post-processing time.
  - use `RETURN_STRICT` when best-effort partial results are acceptable and strictness enforced on post-processing.
  - New parameter `search-global-timeout` acting as cap value to timeout setting on query time TIMEOUT param
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1602, RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1603, RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1604, RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1607, RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1618 JSONPath extensions (MOD-16274, MOD-16275):
  - Projection expressions at the top level of a JSONPath query
  - `==` and `!=` can now compare any literal, including array and object literals
  - Filter negation operator: `!`
  - `size`/`sizeof` and `empty` operators on string, array, object, and nodelist
  - `in` and `nin` operators: membership test on an array and nodelist
  - Operators on numbers: binary `-`, `+`, `*`, `/`, `%`, and unary `-` and `+`
  - Operator on object: `~`
  - `length()` function on array, object, and string
  - Functions on number: `abs()`, `ceiling()`, `floor()`
  - Functions on string: `match()`, `search()`
  - Strings concatenation with `concat()`
  - Functions on array: `first()`, `last()`, `index()`, `append()`
  - Aggregation functions on array: `min()`, `max()`, `avg()`, `sum()`, `stddev()`
  - Function on object: `keys()`
  - Function on nodelist: `count()`
  - Function on nodelist with exactly one node: `value()`
  - Relations functions on array and nodelist: `subsetof()`, `anyof()`, `noneof()`
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2052 New commands: `TS.NRANGE`, `TS.NREVRANGE` - Query a range across multiple time series; group results by timestamp (RED-149232)
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2054 New command: `TS.READ` - optionally blocking read (RED-132421)
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2090 New command: `TS.QUERYLABELS` - Get a list of labels and label-values (RED-132355)
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2072 New command: `TS.MRANGE`, `TS.MREVRANGE` - new `EXCLUDEEMPTY` argument to exclude series with no reported samples (RED-132536)

### Bug fixes (compared to 8.8.0)

- #15478 `SORT`, `GEORADIUS`, `GEORADIUSBYMEMBER`, `XREAD`, `XREADGROUP` - ACL permission bypass
- #15329, #15467 - I/O thread busy looping for replica clients
- #15466 Duplicate KeyMeta restoration in `RESTORE`-based AOF rewrites
- #15462 `MEMORY USAGE` over-reports memory consumption
- #15447 Full sync under heavy write load 
- #15412 Unit mismatch disables the FAST expire cycle stale trigger
- #15392 Crash on `VRANDMEMBER` with `LLONG_MIN` count
- #15409 `CONFIG SET` - crash on of TLS options in non-TLS builds
- #15371 ACL key-name leak in BCAST client-side caching invalidations
- #15433 Signed overflow in `BITFIELD` offset parsing
- #15446 The select-based event loop backend enqueues registered file descriptors that `select()` did not mark ready
- #15309 `mem_clients_normal` drift when a replica drops its cached master after a failed partial resync
- #15357 Crash on missing module numeric config
- #15377 In-progress atomic slot migration tasks keep running on `RM_ResetDataset` and `RM_RdbLoad`
- #15391, #15356, #15436 NULL dereference
- #15390 Overflow on memory unit conversions
- #15291 `SET` does not enforce mutually exclusive `NX`/`XX` and `IF*` options
- #15322 `CONFIG SET` does not reject duplicate arguments when using both primary name and alias
- #15407 `LSET` out-of-range 64-bit index truncation
- #15308 Improve RDB load robustness (streams)
- #15263 Tighter cluster bus parsing for `PING`, `PONG`, and `MEET` packets
- #15247 Partial crash log on LoongArch architecture
- #15270 `VADD ... CAS SETATTR` - wrong attributes count
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10375 `FT.CURSOR READ`: crash after the underlying index was dropped (MOD-16703)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10408 `FT.SEARCH` with `LIMIT` returns too many results in cluster mode over RESP3 (MOD-16767)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10420 `[FT.INFO](http://ft.info/)` could report incorrect values for multi-value TAG fields after document updates (MOD-16745)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10488 `FT.INFO` reports a negative `num_records` after garbage collection on indexes with an `INDEXMISSING` field (MOD-16940)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10392 Vector search:  crash (SIGSEGV) in FP32/L2 distance computation on x86 without AVX support, affecting certain vector dimensions (MOD-16730)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#9963 Range query returns incomplete results when the lower bound is an excluded empty string (MOD-15897)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10066 `FT.AGGREGATE .. WITHCOUNT` coordinator leaks resources on timeout (MOD-16210)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10247 Local `FT.HYBRID` ignores `ON_TIMEOUT RETURN_STRICT` and continues execution past the deadline (MOD-16492)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10255 Blocked search clients trigger unnecessary query dumps, adding CPU and log overhead (MOD-16518)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10151 `FT.HYBRID` supports `EXPLAINSCORE`, exposing the fusion method (`RRF` or `LINEAR`) (MOD-10044)
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1542, RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1543 Wrong results when evaluating paths with recursive descent (MOD-6722, MOD-14664)
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1554 Any literal that starts with true/false/null is interpreted as true/false/null (MOD-7266)
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1600 Improve RDB load robustness
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2067 `TS.INFO` - inaccurate memory usage calculation (MOD-6409)
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2036, RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2053, RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2056, #2074 Aggregation fixes (MOD-8187, MOD-16224, MOD-15565)
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2004, RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2051 Improve RDB load robustness
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2104 Issues after cluster topology changes
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2122 Error on the first cross-shard command (TLS)
- RedisTimeSeries/RedisTimeSeries#2109 `TS.INCRBY` with `TIMESTAMP *` replication timestamp drift
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1014 `CF.LOADCHUNK` partial replication (MOD-16050)
- RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1026, RedisBloom/RedisBloom#1027 Improve RDB load robustness

### Performance and resource utilization improvements (compared to 8.8.0)

- #15376 Optimize `lpSeek()` by validating entries only when necessary
- #15345 Optimize wide `HSET`/`HMSET` on a fresh hash with a single batched listpack append
- #15330 Avoid recomputing allocator fragmentation twice per cron tick (RED-200844)
- #15259 Trim excess SDS allocation in inline command parsing
- #15256 rax memory reduction: leaf-inlining for fixed-length-key trees - improves `XREADGROUP` performance
- #15397 Improve `RESTORE REPLACE` performance for new keys
- #14704 Optimizes an internal memory accounting
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10246 Write operations block on a read lock held throughout vector range query result collection (MOD-16437)
- RediSearch/RediSearch#10392 Vector search: Reduce HNSW index memory usage with one-byte per-node locks (MOD-16696).
- RedisJSON/RedisJSON#1617 JSON - memory object footprint improvements (MOD-16608)

### Modules API

- #15350 `RedisModuleEvent_ClusterTopologyChange` - cluster topology change
- #15327 `REDISMODULE_SUBEVENT_FORK_CHILD_*` - allow multi-threaded modules can quiesce background work before `fork()`
- #15373 `REDISMODULE_SUBEVENT_CLUSTER_SLOT_MIGRATION_MIGRATE_MODULE_PROPAGATE_END` - inject commands after ASM replication stream
- #15242 `RedisModule_AddPostNotificationJobForKey` - binds deferred work to a specific key from a keyspace-notification handler

### Configuration parameters

- #15364 Compact hashes:
  - `hash-rdb-load-min-template-entries` - minimum field count to convert a plain hash to a template during load
  - `hash-rdb-load-max-template-entries` - maximum field count for load-time conversion
  - `hash-rdb-load-template-disassembly-threshold` - minimum number of keys a converted template must end up with to be kept

### Metrics

- #15364 Compact hashes:
  - `INFO STATS` - `hash_templates` - number of distinct compact hash templates
  - `INFO STATS` - `hash_template_keys` - total number of keys backed by a compact hash template
  - `INFO MEMORY` - `used_memory_hash_templates` - total memory used by all compact hash templates
  - `MEMORY STATS` - `hash.templates` - total memory used by all compact hash templates
  - `MEMORY USAGE <key>` reports the key’s own + plus its share of a compact hash template cost

### CLI tools

- #15352 Adds `--latency-percentiles <p1,p2,...>` to `--latency` / `--latency-history`: reporting user-chosen percentiles
- #15262 `redis-cli --cluster rebalance` - CROSSSLOT error on when using `-user` without `-a`
- #15338 `redis-cli --cluster reshard` and `rebalance` now move slots with server-side atomic slot migration

This is the General Availability release of Redis 8.8 in Redis Open Source.

### Major changes compared to 8.6

- New data structure: Array (@antirez)
- Subkey notification for hash fields - field-level notifications
- `INCREX`: a window counter rate limiter combining `INCR`, `INCRBY`, `INCRBYFLOAT`, bounds, and expiration (@raffertyyu + Redis team)

This is the General Availability release of Redis 8.6 in Redis Open Source.

- Substantial performance improvements
- Substantial memory reduction for hashes (hashtable-encoded) and sorted sets (skiplist-encoded)

This is the General Availability release of Redis 8.4 in Redis Open Source.

### Major changes compared to 8.2

- [DIGEST](https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/digest/), [DELEX](https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/delex/); [SET](https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/set/) extensions - atomic compare-and-set and compare-and-delete for string keys

  - (3) Time series

The following upgrade paths (by replication or persistence) to 8.0-M01 are not yet tested and will be introduced in upcoming pre-releases:
- From previous Redis versions with modules (RediSearch, RedisJSON, RedisTimeSeries, RedisBloom)
- From Redis Stack 7.2 or 7.4

### New Features in binary distributions

- 7 new data structures: JSON, Time series, Bloom filter, Cuckoo filter, Count-min sketch, Top-k, t-digest
- Redis scalable query engine (including vector search)

### Potentially breaking changes

- #12272 `GETRANGE` returns an empty bulk when the negative end index is out of range
- #12395 Optimize `SCAN` command when matching data type

### Bug fixes

- #13510 Fix `RM_RdbLoad` to enable AOF after RDB loading is completed
- #13489 `ACL CAT` - return module commands
- #13476 Fix a race condition in the `cache_memory` of `functionsLibCtx`
- #13473 Fix incorrect lag due to trimming stream via `XTRIM` command
- #13338 Fix incorrect lag field in `XINFO` when tombstone is after the `last_id` of the consume group
- #13470 On `HDEL` of last field - update the global hash field expiration data structure
- #13465 Cluster: Pass extensions to node if extension processing is handled by it
- #13443 Cluster: Ensure validity of myself when loading cluster config
- #13422 Cluster: Fix `CLUSTER SHARDS` command returns empty array

### Modules API

- #13509 New API calls: `RM_DefragAllocRaw`, `RM_DefragFreeRaw`, and `RM_RegisterDefragCallbacks` - defrag API to allocate and free raw memory

### Performance and resource utilization improvements

- #13503 Avoid overhead of comparison function pointer calls in listpack `lpFind`
- #13505 Optimize `STRING` datatype write commands
- #13499 Optimize `SMEMBERS` command
- #13494 Optimize `GEO*` commands reply
- #13490 Optimize `HELLO` command
- #13488 Optimize client query buffer
- #12395 Optimize `SCAN` command when matching data type
- #13529 Optimize `LREM`, `LPOS`, `LINSERT`, and `LINDEX` commands
- #13516 Optimize `LRANGE` and other commands that perform several writes to client buffers per call
- #13431 Avoid `used_memory` contention when updating from multiple threads

### Other general improvements

- #13495 Reply `-LOADING` on replica while flushing the db

### CLI tools

- #13411 redis-cli: Fix wrong `dbnum` showed after the client reconnected

### Notes

- No backward compatibility for replication or persistence.
- Additional distributions, upgrade paths, features, and improvements will be introduced in upcoming pre-releases.
- With the GA release of 8.0 we will deprecate Redis Stack.

This is the General Availability release of Redis Community Edition 7.4.

data.name: 7.4-rc1
data.body:
Note: License changed - see LICENSE.txt

Upgrade urgency LOW: This is the first Release Candidate for Redis Community Edition 7.4.

Here is a comprehensive list of changes in this release compared to 7.2.5.

New Features
============
* #13303 Hash - expiration of individual fields. 9 commands were introduced:
  - `HEXPIRE` and `HPEXPIRE` set the remaining time to live for specific fields
  - `HEXPIREAT` and `HPEXPIREAT` set the expiration time to a UNIX timestamp for specific fields
  - `HPERSIST` removes the expiration for specific fields
  - `HEXPIRETIME` and `HPEXPIRETIME` get the expiration time for specific fields
  - `HTTL` and `HPTTL` get the remaining time to live for specific fields
* #13117 `XREAD`: new id value `+` to start reading from the last message
* #12765 `HSCAN`: new `NOVALUES` flag to report only field names
* #12728 `SORT`, `SORT_RO`: allow `BY` and `GET` options in cluster mode when the pattern maps to the same slot as the key
* #12299 `CLIENT KILL`: new optional filter: `MAXAGE maxage` - kill connections older than `maxage` seconds
* #12971 Lua: expose `os.clock()` API for getting the elapsed time of Lua code execution
* #13276 Allow `SPUBLISH` command within `MULTI ... EXEC` transactions on replica

Bug fixes
=========
* #12898 `XREADGROUP`: fix entries-read inconsistency between master and replicas
* #13042 `SORT ... STORE`: fix created lists to respect list compression and packing configs
* #12817, #12905 Fix race condition issues between the main thread and module threads
* #12577 Unsubscribe all clients from replica for shard channel if the master ownership changes
* #12622 `WAITAOF` could timeout or hang if used after a module command that propagated effects only to replicas and not to AOF
* #11734 `BITCOUNT` and `BITPOS` with nonexistent key and illegal arguments return an error, not 0
* #12394 `BITCOUNT`: check for wrong argument before checking if key exists
* #12961 Allow execution of read-only transactions when out of memory
* #13274 Fix crash when a client performs ACL change that disconnects itself
* #13311 Cluster: Fix crash due to unblocking client during slot migration

Security improvements
=====================
* #13108 Lua: LRU eviction for scripts generated with `EVAL` *** BEHAVIOR CHANGE ***
* #12961 Restrict the total request size of `MULTI ... EXEC` transactions
* #12860 Redact ACL username information and mark `*-key-file-pass configs` as sensitive


Performance and resource utilization improvements
=================================================
* #12838 Improve performance when many clients call `PUNSUBSCRIBE` / `SUNSUBSCRIBE` simultaneously
* #12627 Reduce lag when waking `WAITAOF` clients and there is not much traffic
* #12754 Optimize `KEYS` when pattern includes hashtag and implies a single slot
* #11695 Reduce memory and improve performance by replacing cluster metadata with slot specific dictionaries
* #13087 `SCRIPT FLUSH ASYNC` now does not block the main thread
* #12996 Active memory defragmentation efficiency improvements
* #12899 Improve performance of read/update operation during rehashing
* #12536 `SCAN ... MATCH`: Improve performance when the pattern implies cluster slot
* #12450 `ZRANGE ... LIMIT`: improved performance


Other general improvements
==========================
* #13133 Lua: allocate VM code with jemalloc instead of libc and count it as used memory *** BEHAVIOR CHANGE ***
* #12171 `ACL LOAD`: do not disconnect all clients *** BEHAVIOR CHANGE ***
* #13020 Allow adjusting defrag configurations while active defragmentation is running
* #12949 Increase the accuracy of avg_ttl (the average keyspace keys TTL)
* #12977 Allow running `WAITAOF` in scripts
* #12782 Implement TCP Keep-Alives across most Unix-like systems
* #12707 Improved error codes when rejecting scripts in cluster mode
* #12596 Support `XREAD ... BLOCK` in scripts; rejected only if it ends up blocking

New metrics
===========
* #12849 `INFO`: `pubsub_clients` - number of clients in Pub/Sub mode
* #12966 `INFO`: `watching_clients` - number of clients that are watching keys
* #12966 `INFO`: `total_watched_keys` - number of watched keys
* #12476 `INFO`: `client_query_buffer_limit_disconnections` - count client input buffer OOM events
* #12476 `INFO`: `client_output_buffer_limit_disconnections` - count client output buffer OOM events
* #12996 `INFO`: `allocator_muzzy` - memory returned to the OS but still shows as RSS until the OS reclaims it
* #13108 `INFO`: `evicted_scripts` - number of evicted eval scripts. Users can check it to see if they are abusing EVAL
* #12996 `MEMORY STATS`: `allocator.muzzy` - memory returned to the OS but still shows as RSS until the OS reclaims it
* #12913 `INFO MEMORY` `mem_overhead_db_hashtable_rehashing` - memory resharding overhead (only the memory that will be released soon)
* #12913 `MEMORY STATS`: `overhead.db.hashtable.lut` - total overhead of dictionary buckets in databases
* #12913 `MEMORY STATS`: `overhead.db.hashtable.rehashing` - temporary memory overhead of database dictionaries currently being rehashed 
* #12913 `MEMORY STATS`: `db.dict.rehashing.count` - number of top level dictionaries currently being rehashed
* #12966 `CLIENT LIST`: `watch` - number of keys each client is currently watching

Modules API
===========
* #12985 New API calls: `RM_TryCalloc` and `RM_TryRealloc` - allow modules to handle memory allocation failures gracefully
* #13069 New API call: `RM_ClusterKeySlot` - which slot a key will hash to
* #13069 New API call: `RM_ClusterCanonicalKeyNameInSlot` - get a consistent key that will map to a slot 
* #12486 New API call: `RM_AddACLCategory` - allow modules to declare new ACL categories


Configuration parameters
========================


* #12178 New configuration parameters: `max-new-connections-per-cycle` and `max-new-tls-connections-per-cycle` to limit the number of new client connections per event-loop cycle
* #7351 Rename some CPU configuration parameters for style alignment. Added alias to the old names to avoid breaking change

CLI tools
=========
* #10609 redis-cli: new `-t <timeout>` argument: specify server connection timeout in seconds
* #11315 redis-cli: new `-4` and `-6` flags to prefer IPV4 or IPV6 on DNS lookup
* #12862 redis-cli: allows pressing up arrow to return any command (including sensitive commands which are still not persisted)
* #12543 redis-cli: add reverse history search (like Ctrl+R in terminals)
* #12826 redis-cli: add `--keystats` and `--keystats-samples` to combines `--memkeys` and `--bigkeys` with additional distribution data
* #12735 redis-cli: fix: `--bigkeys` and `--memkeys` now work on cluster replicas
* #9411 redis-benchmark: add support for binary strings
* #12986 redis-benchmark: fix: pick random slot for a node to distribute operation across slots
